core_obligations: Reduce to affine local rings and translate the three conditions into module conditions (proof lines 12388-12397).
Prove (1) implies (2) from finiteness of the presentation (proof lines 12397-12399).
Prove (2) implies (1) via finite presentation and projectivity of the module (proof lines 12399-12406).
Add the locally Noetherian case (3) using finiteness of the presentation over a Noetherian ring (proof lines 12406-12408).
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies finite locally free morphisms with finite, flat morphisms locally of finite presentation, and records that over a locally Noetherian base finite flat already suffices. The proof works affine locally, where the morphism is given by a ring map and the three conditions become module-theoretic: a finite free module is finitely presented; conversely a finite, finitely presented and flat module is finitely presented as a module, hence finite locally free; and over a Noetherian ring a finite module is finitely presented, which gives the third equivalence.
